mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within the past 3 months signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in real economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary monetary policy regime, a CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% annualized signals rising inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized in the inflationary regime, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1,200,000 units per month signals weakness in the real estate sector and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO does not produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) decline below 1.5% annualized signals an economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 1.5% annualized in the late-cycle regime, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
